smt-2013-algebra-tiebreaker-01.prompt: $x$ is a base-10 number such that when the digits of $x$ are interpreted as a base-$20$ number, the resulting number is twice the value as when they are interpreted as a base-$13$ number. Find the sum of all possible values of $x$.

smt-2013-algebra-tiebreaker-03.prompt: Find the minimum of $f(x,y,z)=x^3+\dfrac{12yz}{x}+16\left(\dfrac{1}{yz}\right)^{3/2}$ where $x$, $y$, and $z$ are all positive.
